proposal.reason: Main functional change is in enqueue: kernel launch now passes an explicit argument-buffer pointer plus actual byte count to hgLaunchKernelExAD, enabling variable-length arguments and a 4 KiB budget. Add symmetric because symmetric multi-task planning/lifetime changed to allocate argument buffers by computed size and propagate actual kernelArgsSize. Add kernels because collective kernel declarations/definitions changed their by-value argument ABI from 1 KiB storage to 4 KiB storage, which is a substantive kernel-interface update.
